name: taghunter-playground
description: Run game-simulator campaigns in the Tag Hunter Playground tester build on this PC and record a verdict for each run.
long_description: Say "Launch the Playground simulations": Claude checks which launch configurations are untested, starts a campaign that plays each one on the visible game page (mock teams, real game screens), then proposes a Pass/Partial/Fail verdict per run for the tester to confirm. Needs the Playground TESTER build running on the same PC.

tools.name: playground_info
tools.description: App version, devices and the current campaign.

tools.name: list_scenarios
tools.description: Downloaded scenarios the simulator can play.

tools.name: coverage
tools.description: Which launch configurations have passed, and the gaps.

tools.name: estimate_campaign
tools.description: Run count and rough duration of a campaign.

tools.name: start_campaign
tools.description: Start a series of simulated sessions.

tools.name: campaign_status
tools.description: The current campaign and its runs.

tools.name: record_verdict
tools.description: Save a confirmed verdict to Studio.

prompts.name: launch_playground_simulations
prompts.description: Check what is untested, run a campaign and judge each run.
prompts.text: Launch the Playground simulations. Start with playground_info and coverage, summarise what is untested, ask me which series to run unless it is obvious, then run it and propose a verdict for each finished run for me to confirm.
